title: Character Design Interview
content: I'm really excited to have been interviewed by theCharacter Design blog. If you scroll down to end of the chat, there is a portfolio of 35 drawings that I did of people, animals, and cars, mostly from observation.The blog has a very deep archive of interviews with artists who work for the most part in the field of concept art, character design and animation, such asNate Wragg,Jason Deamer, andKei AcederaCharacter Design interview with James G.List of all interviews on Character Design
